description:
README.md lines 119-134 lists what is validated in v0.2:
- 'Name constraints — RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 (DNS, RFC 822, URI, DirectoryName)'
- 'Certificate policies — RFC 5280 §6.1 policy state machine'
- 'Policy mappings'
- etc.

pkix-path/src/lib.rs (module-level doc, lines 23-29) says:
'v0.1 does not implement: ... These are tracked for v0.2+.'

There is an inconsistency: the README says v0.2 includes name constraints and policy features, implying these ARE implemented. The lib.rs doc still says 'v0.1 does not implement' these features (which appears to be outdated). Looking at the actual code, name constraints, policy state machine, policy mappings, etc. ARE all implemented in the code. 

The lib.rs doc comment has not been updated from v0.1 to reflect v0.2 scope. The crate Limitations section (lines 23-29) is stale — it lists NC, cross-cert path building, and RFC 4518 as 'not implemented for v0.1' but NC IS now implemented.

Suggested fix: Update pkix-path/src/lib.rs module-level doc to reflect v0.2 scope. The only remaining v0.2+ limitation mentioned in both README and lib.rs is RFC 4518 full Unicode NFKC DN normalization.

P3 — documentation mismatch.
title: README claims pkix-path v0.2 has NameConstraints; crate lib.rs doc says v0.2 planned
